scenes.basis: 12:3 "he proceeded to seize Peter also" - the arrest, the prison and the escape name no place; 12:19 "He went down from Judea to Caesarea" shows Herod leaving Jerusalem
12:19 "He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there" - the Tyre and Sidon delegation and Herod's death follow at Caesarea
12:24 "But the word of God grew and multiplied" - a summary with no place
12:25 "Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their service"
